items.title: Sylvester Handy Interview, 1961-12-13
items.q: I once heard Slowgag do that once.

ctx.x: Just like I'd hold it on a table or on a chair or anything.
And I'd get the sound of the bass on that... On this finger. I've heard that. I once heard Slowgag do that once. Well... He held his finger on the door.
